cat > /app/prep.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, re
def clean(t):
    t = t.replace('\n',' ').lower()
    t = re.sub(r"([.!?,/()\"';:])", r" \1 ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"\s+"," ",t).strip()
    return t
for split in ['train','test']:
    df = pd.read_parquet(f'/app/data/{split}-00000-of-00001.parquet')
    with open(f'/app/{split}.txt','w') as f:
        for lab,txt in zip(df['label'],df['text']):
            f.write(f"__label__{lab} {clean(txt)}\n")
    print(split, len(df))
EOF
